design.cleaning_policy: Sort dates; collapse identical selected-rate duplicates, reject conflicting duplicates; drop missing/non-finite/non-positive rate rows with full audit; never forward fill; preserve flagged extreme returns; use actual calendar gaps.
design.scope: Historical FX reference data calibrate volatility only. Synthetic $100 price-normalized instruments demonstrate the unchanged execution core. Impact, risk preference and intraday diffusion remain assumptions. No real-trade backtest.
design.holdout_policy: Freeze training on 2022-2023; evaluate 2024-2025. Rolling parameters use returns ending no later than the previous reference date. Current historical snapshot is not a point-in-time vintage.

source_metadata.snapshot_type: current historical snapshot; not a point-in-time vintage
source_metadata.transformation_notice: Derived cross-rates, sorted/filtered study subset, log returns and volatility statistics are researcher modifications. Original archive bytes are unmodified.
source_metadata.reference_rate_limit: Reference rates are for information purposes; not actual executable transaction quotes.
